title: Claude give me main screen vs give me main page inspired by this game
author: Longjumping_Wall9861
selftext:
I've recently played and finished Here Comes the Horde and I guess after the credits it redirects you back to main menu you can see game playing in the background with the buttons on the actual game screen. I probably seen it hundreds of times in games but when looked at from a  game development perspective it looks cool so I replaced my generic homepage that Claude built months ago with something new.

It is basically the combat of my idle game , + switching characters skins and maps of the game like a show room.
